title: Runner Says Sorry for Riding a Bike in the Berlin Marathon
summary:
A marathon is a race of about 26.2 miles. Runners must run the whole way. But at the Berlin Marathon on Sept. 27, one runner seems to have taken a ride instead.

Photos appeared to show a Chinese fitness influencer riding on the back of a bike during the race. She goes by Abeeeer on the app Rednote, where she has 520,000 followers. An Instagram account that checks race results first shared the photos.

On Saturday, she posted a "sincere apology." She said she felt unwell, but that was not an excuse. "My behaviour to take a shortcut was disrespectful to the spirit of the marathon," she wrote.

The shoe company Brooks said Brooks China ended its work with her. "Brooks believes running should be grounded in integrity, fairness, and respect for competition," the company said.

More than 56,000 runners from 162 countries entered the race.
why_it_matters: Playing fair matters in every race and game, even when you are tired.
